781683c345ae5e6a.src: SuppDB leads with its Safety & Interaction Layer — {0} supplement × drug interactions, per-product % of the tolerable upper limit, condition contraindications and WADA flags — on top of a structured catalog of {1} real supplement & nootropic products from {2} brands, built exclusively from the public NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (DSLD). Every active ingredient is normalized to milligrams, proprietary blends are flagged where the dose is hidden, and each compound is enriched with NIH PubChem chemistry — with a source label URL on every record so any fact can be re-verified. A separate <3>Safety layer</3> builds on the normalized doses: {4} supplement–drug interactions, per-product percentage of the tolerable upper limit, condition contraindications, and WADA doping flags — every interaction cited to its public-domain source.

Uma <3>camada de segurança</3> separada se apoia nas doses normalizadas: {4} interações suplemento–medicamento, percentual do limite superior tolerável por produto, contraindicações por condição e sinalizações de doping WADA — cada interação citada com sua fonte de domínio público.
